description: There is no stopping you when gaming on the Lenovo G25-10 monitor. With a high frame rate and vibrant colors, the 62.23 cm (24.5-inch) Full-HD monitor is perfect for E-Sports enthusiasts. A faster refresh rate of 144 Hz and a quick response time of 1ms will allow you to enjoy seamless gameplay. Powered by NVIDIA G-SYNC Compatible technology, the monitor provides smooth visual delivery with virtually no screen tearing. Gaming for extended hours on the G25-10 is comfortable with its eye-care technology, anti-glare display, and 110 mm lift range stand.
